derivation: Experimenter-authored for EXP-2 phase 1 from repository structure only: Praxis.slnx, the ProjectReference graph (Domain <- Contracts <- Application <- Infrastructure <- Cli <- Praxis.Tests; SiteTools <- Site.Tests), the EmbeddedResource items of Praxis.Infrastructure.fsproj and Directory.Build.props (release.json read at build), tests that resolve the repository root at run time, and the push/paths filters of .github/workflows/*.yml. No CI outcome was consulted.
glob_semantics: Paths are repository-relative. '**' matches any sequence of characters including '/'; '*' matches any sequence without '/'; a pattern without a wildcard matches exactly that path.
unmapped_policy_note: A changed path that matches no path class selects every job (conservative). Deletions and renames are evaluated on both old and new paths.

cli_closure.description: Inputs of src/Praxis.Cli and its transitive project closure, including every embedded resource and build-wide file.

test_closure.description: Praxis.Tests inputs beyond the CLI closure: the test project, its fixtures, and repository files the tests read at run time (wrappers, scripts, identity and boundary configuration, toolchain pins, CI composite actions).

site.description: Public site inputs, taken verbatim from the push.paths filter of site.yml.

release_tooling.description: Native release inputs, from the push.paths filter of native-release.yml.

other_workflows.description: Workflows that never run on push to main (dispatch, PR-only, inbox branches). Changing them affects no push-to-main job.

governance_and_docs.description: Repository governance state and prose that no build or filtered test suite consumes. They are checked by `praxis validate`, `praxis registry check` and the pinned-release suite, which are mandatory jobs here and so always run.

jobs.mandatory_reason: Carries the RELEASE-GATES §2 checks Praxis has: `praxis validate` (telemetry credential and secret-field rejection: §2.1; Aegis authorization boundaries: §2.2-2.3; frozen-state and registry integrity: §2.4), `praxis architecture check`, `praxis registry check`, and the 'tests leave the checkout unchanged' data-integrity step. Selection is job-level, so the unfiltered F# and browser suites in this job also always run.
Producer/consumer contract: the pinned release (.echelon/toolchain.json) must accept this repository (§2.5). Its suite validates the whole repository, so every path selects it anyway.

jobs.note: A deployment, not a verification. Its build step repeats the site verify of site-check. Redeploying unchanged inputs is redundant.

jobs.mandatory_reason: Release acceptance (§2.6): builds, attests and publishes release assets. It runs only when its own path filter fires, and the replay never deselects it.

unknown_job_policy: A historical job that matches no entry is treated as mandatory (always selected) and listed in the results.

checks.description: Check equivalence for cross-job detection: a failing step in a skipped job counts as detected at a commit when an executed job there fails at a step running the same check.
site-verify: ^Structure, references, accessibility rules, boundary, evidence, tests$

select_when_semantics: Each select_when entry is a path-class id, or a glob when it is not a class id. 'always' selects the job on every push. A job with 'follows' is selected only when the named job is selected.
